Irina Jorgenson, DDS
General, Restorative & Sedation Dentistry
Dr. Irina Jorgenson was born in Kiev, Ukraine, and came to the U.S. at 16. She earned her Bachelor of Science in Microbiology, Cell Biology, and Chemistry with a Math minor, then graduated from UNC School of Dentistry. She completed a General Practice Residency at UNC Hospitals, training in IV sedation and dental sleep medicine. Fluent in Russian, she focuses on comprehensive care, cosmetic dentistry, and sleep medicine. Outside work, she enjoys her children, running, kayaking, history, and the beach.
VIEW PROFILE
John Corcoran, DDS

MORE+
John Corcoran, DDS
General & Restorative Dentistry
Dr. John Corcoran, hailing from Cleveland, Ohio, grew up in Oxford, just outside Cincinnati. Inspired by shadowing his family dentist, he fell in love with dentistry, drawn to helping people and the ability to diagnose and treat in one place. He attended Miami University for undergrad and dental school at The Ohio State University. Dr. Corcoran spent 7 years in the USAF, including 1 year as chief of dental services at Seymour Johnson AFB. A perfectionist, he pursues lifelong learning. Outside dentistry, he enjoys sports, exercise, traveling, and once played baseball in Argentina.

Dr. You Seen Seo was born in South Korea, raised in Vancouver, and earned her DDS from NYU in 2019. Accepted into a seven-year dental program in high school, she’s practiced in Illinois, New York, and previously Garner, NC. Known for her gentle, preventive approach, Dr. Seo values patient comfort and education. Outside work, she enjoys family time, cooking, knitting, and exploring coffee shops. She speaks English and Korean.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Can I get professional teeth whitening at Cary West?

Yes, professional teeth whitening and other cosmetic dental procedures are available at our Cary West location.

How do you ensure comfort during wisdom tooth removal?

Our trained and qualified staff ensure comfort during wisdom tooth removal through the use of sedation or general anesthesia during the surgery itself. In the immediate aftermath of the surgery, pain medication and cold compresses (ice packs) may be used to manage swelling, soreness or pain. This generally abates within 48-72 hours, though it will take somewhat longer for the surgery site to fully heal.

What insurance plans do you accept at Cary West?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

Do you have same-day appointments/emergency dental care for urgent dental pain or swelling?

Yes - we offer emergency dental care. We make every effort to see emergency patients same day if our office is open and staffed or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our Benson location, we have offices throughout the region that may be able to accommodate short notice, after hours, or weekend visits for emergencies.
